x: Winter training is essential for early season track and field successes and we are proud that UK Champions Mike Winch and Judy Oakes have started coaching sessions at Belgrave Hall as a prelude to building up a centre of excellence for strength and mobility training following our Belgrave Hall Development Programme.

A key improvement will be due to the use of the gymnasium by Mike Winch and Judy Oakes who will for three days per week be running special strength and mobility sessions not only for athletes but also for other Sportsmen and members of the general public.
Within three weeks of opening Mike Winch and Judy Oakes reported full capacity with opening on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m.
